changelog.name: PlayVersionSpoofer V1.7
changelog.body:
## PlayVersionSpoofer 1.7

This release improves compatibility with older and newer Google Play Store versions and changes how self-updates are blocked.

### What's new

- Improved compatibility across older and newer Play Store versions
- Uses a minimal hook scope to reduce compatibility issues and unexpected behavior
- The Play Store now displays its real installed version instead of `999.999.999`
- Manual update checks still report that Google Play Store is up to date
- Normal app updates remain unaffected
- Added an optional Legacy fallback for unsupported versions

# PlayVersionSpoofer [中文](#chinese) An Xposed module that prevents Google Play Store from automatically updating **itself**. ## 🚀 Features - Makes Google Play Store report that it is up to date - Prevents only Play Store self-updates - Does not affect normal app updates ## 🔍 How to Verify PlayVersionSpoofer is Working 1. Open Google Play Store 2. Tap the profile icon in the top-right corner 3. Open **Settings** 4. Scroll down to the **About** section 5. Tap **Update Play Store** If it reports that **Google Play Store is up to date**, the module is working correctly.

    

> **📝 Note**: Seeing the real installed Play Store version is expected. If the default mode does not work with your Play Store version, enable **Legacy PackageInfo fallback** in the module app, then force stop and reopen Google Play Store. Use the fallback only when necessary. ## 📋 Requirements - Rooted Android device - Xposed Framework (LSPosed recommended) - Android 9.0 or newer ## 🔧 Installation 1. Download and install the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/byemaxx/PlayVersionSpoofer/releases) 2. Enable the module in LSPosed 3. Select **Google Play Store** as the module scope 4. Force stop and reopen Google Play Store 5. Open the PlaySpoofer app to check the module status ## ⚠️ Disclaimer This project is intended for educational and personal use. Use it at your own risk. If you find this module useful, please [Star the project](https://github.com/byemaxx/PlayVersionSpoofer). Contributions and suggestions are welcome. --- # PlayVersionSpoofer 中文 [English](#playversionspoofer) 一个阻止 Google Play 商店进行**自我更新**的 Xposed 模块。 ## 🚀 功能特点 - 让 Google Play 商店提示当前已是最新版本 - 仅阻止 Play 商店自我更新 - 不影响普通应用更新 ## 🔍 如何验证 PlayVersionSpoofer 是否正常工作 1. 打开 Google Play 商店 2. 点击右上角的个人资料图标 3. 打开“设置” 4. 向下滚动到“关于” 5. 点击“更新 Play 商店” 如果提示 **Google Play 商店已是最新版本**，说明模块工作正常。

    

> **📝 注意**：显示 Play 商店的真实安装版本属于正常行为。如果默认模式不支持当前 Play 商店版本，可在模块应用中启用 **旧版 PackageInfo fallback**，然后强行停止并重新打开 Play 商店。仅建议在确有需要时启用 fallback。 ## 📋 使用要求 - 已 Root 的 Android 设备 - Xposed 框架（推荐使用 LSPosed） - Android 9.0 或更高版本 ## 🔧 安装方法 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/byemaxx/PlayVersionSpoofer/releases) 下载并安装 APK 2. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块 3. 选择 **Google Play Store** 作为模块作用域 4. 强行停止并重新打开 Google Play 商店 5. 打开 PlaySpoofer 应用检查模块状态 ## ⚠️ 免责声明 本项目仅用于个人学习和研究，使用风险自负。 如果觉得这个模块有用，请为[项目点一个 Star](https://github.com/byemaxx/PlayVersionSpoofer)。欢迎提交贡献和建议。
